name: Clay
shortDescription: Sales data workspace with a marketplace of 200+ providers and a free trial.
longDescription: Clay's pricing page describes centralizing data sources, buying data from 200+ providers, and tracking intent signals, and it offers a free trial. The page did not include a dollar price or a trial length.
pricingNotes: The pricing page describes a data marketplace of 200+ providers and a free trial. No dollar amount or trial length was in the fetch.
bestFor: Building lead lists from many data providers in one table
notIdealFor: Someone who needs a published seat price before a trial
strength: Clay describes a data marketplace of more than 200 providers and offers a free trial on the pricing page.
weakness: The pricing page did not state a dollar price or how many days the trial lasts.

useCaseFit.sales-outreach: Pulls sales data from a marketplace of more than 200 providers, with a free trial.
